titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Wood That Saves (ch. 104)
about: The preacher lists the wood by which God has saved: Noah's ark, Abraham's tree, Isaac's ram, Jacob's rods and staff, the Ark of Moses and David, and finally the cross. The Ark is given many names, and the saints' arks are defended through Christ's words on his true family, the staff of Jacob, and Moses' rod against Pharaoh's sorcerers. The chapter ends on Hebrews 11, the curse of the Law, and Mark 16:16.

sentences.t: ፻፬ ፡ ካዕበ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ታቦት ፡ ወነገረ ፡ ዕልዋን ።
sentences.l: 104. Again concerning ark and-matter-of ʿəlwan (?)
sentences.i: Chapter 104: Again, Concerning the Ark and the Case of the Perverse (?)
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፻፬ is 100 + 4. ካዕበ 'again' and በእንተ 'concerning' (taking the construct) are the usual formulas. ወነገረ is 'and the matter of' (ወ- + construct of ነገር); the printed form could also be read as a verb, but a noun fits. ዕልዋን I take as a plural of ዕሉው 'perverse, crooked' (?): 'the case of the perverse ones'. Dillmann is unavailable, so this is a guess from the chapter's content (the wrong-teaching 'blind Jew' and the deceived), and I hedge it.

sentences.t: ወበእንተ ፡ ታቦትሰ ፡ አድኀኖ ፡ ለኖኅ ፡ በታቦት ፤
sentences.l: and-concerning ark-indeed he-saved-him to-Noah by-ark;
sentences.i: And concerning the Ark: He saved Noah by an ark;
sentences.n: The chapter opens with a list of 'wood' by which God saved people, building to the Ark and the cross. Here the first is Noah's ark (Genesis 6–8): ታቦት is the same word as for the Ark of the Covenant, which is the point of the wordplay. ታቦትሰ: the enclitic -ሰ gives 'as for the ark'. አድኀኖ ለኖኅ: the verb carries the suffix -ኦ 'him', doubled by ለኖኅ 'Noah' (the house habit of ለ- marking the object after an anticipating suffix). God is the unstated subject. A pattern to watch through the list: 'He saved/spoke/enriched X by wood'.

sentences.t: ወተናገሮ ፡ ለአብርሃም ፡ በኀበ ፡ ዕፀ ፡ መንበር ፡ ዘውእቱ ፡ ዕፅ ፡ ዘኢይነቅዝ ፤
sentences.l: and-he-spoke-with-him to-Abraham at tree-of seat which-(is) tree which-not-it-rots;
sentences.i: and He spoke with Abraham at the tree of the seat, that is, the wood that does not rot;
sentences.n: Probably Genesis 18:1, where the LORD appears to Abraham at the oaks of Mamre; ዕፀ መንበር 'tree of (the) seat/throne' is my literal rendering and I do not know that it is a set name for Mamre (?). ወተናገሮ: reciprocal ተ-stem, 'spoke with him', + ለአብርሃም doubling the suffix. በኀበ 'at, by' here. ዘውእቱ 'that is, namely'. ዘኢይነቅዝ 'which does not rot' (ዘ + ኢ + 3ms imperfect of ነቀዘ): the 'incorruptible wood' is the stock phrase for the wood of the Ark (cf. Exodus 25:10, acacia), so Abraham's tree is quietly identified with the Ark's timber.

sentences.t: ወአድኀኖ ፡ ለይስሐቅ ፡ በዘ ፡ ተእኅዘ ፡ በዕፀ ፡ ሳቤቅ ፡ በግዕ ፤
sentences.l: and-he-saved-him to-Isaac in-that-which it-was-seized in-tree-of Sabek ram;
sentences.i: and He saved Isaac by what was caught in the tree of Sabek, a ram;
sentences.n: Genesis 22:13, the ram caught by its horns in the thicket. ሳቤቅ is the transliterated Hebrew səbak 'thicket' (the Greek Old Testament also leaves it as a transliterated word at Genesis 22:13); the author takes it as a 'tree', ዕፀ ሳቤቅ, in his wood-list. The glossary's 'Sabek (?)' stays hedged. በዘ ተእኅዘ 'by that which was seized' (relative ዘ + 3ms passive ተእኅዘ of አኀዘ); በግዕ 'ram' is in apposition. So Isaac is saved by what was caught in a tree.

sentences.t: ወአብዐሎ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ በ፫ ፡ አብትረ ፡ ዕፀው ፡ እለ ፡ ወደየ ፡ ኰሳኵሰ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማይ ፤
sentences.l: and-he-enriched-him to-Jacob with-3 rods-of woods which he-put kʷäsakʷəsä (?) in water;
sentences.i: and He made Jacob rich with three rods of wood, which he put, peeled (?), into the water;
sentences.n: Genesis 30:37–43, Jacob's striped rods in the watering troughs by which his flock multiplied. አብዐሎ: causative of the root b-ʿ-l 'be rich' (ብዕል; the G verb itself not checked), 'he enriched him'. በ፫: the numeral is read 'three' (the Genesis story names three kinds of tree, poplar, almond and plane; the number is the author's here). አብትረ ዕፀው 'rods of woods' is a construct. እለ ወደየ: plural relative with a 3ms verb (ወደየ 'he put', ወ is a root letter), subject Jacob. ኰሳኵሰ (kʷäsakʷəsä): I cannot place this; I guess 'peeled, stripped' from the story (Genesis 30:37), as an accusative or adverb, and I mark it (?). Dillmann would settle it.

sentences.t: ወበከተማ ፡ በትሩ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ ተባረከ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፤
sentences.l: and-by-top(?) staff-his of-Jacob he-was-blessed Joseph;
sentences.i: and by the tip (?) of Jacob's staff Joseph was blessed;
sentences.n: Allusion to Genesis 47:31 as the Greek Old Testament and Hebrews 11:21 give it: Jacob 'bowed upon the top of his staff'. The author reads the scene so that the staff itself is honoured (see unit 25). ከተማ here cannot be the usual 'city'; since ከተመ means 'to seal, close, end', I take ከተማ as 'tip, top, end' (?). በትሩ ለያዕቆብ: the suffix on 'his staff' anticipates 'of Jacob' (ለ- naming the owner). ተባረከ: passive-reflexive 'was blessed'. Note that Genesis and Hebrews make Jacob the one who blesses and bows; the source puts Joseph in the scene, and I keep it as printed.

sentences.t: ወለሙሴኒ ፡ ይቤሎ ፡ ግበር ፡ ታቦተ ፡ እምዕፅ ፡ ዘኢይነቅዝ ፡ በአምሳሊሃ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ኪዳን ፤
sentences.l: and-to-Moses-also he-said-to-him: 'make ark from-wood which-not-it-rots in-likeness-of-her to-Zion ark-of covenant';
sentences.i: And to Moses also He said: 'Make an ark of wood that does not rot, in the likeness of Zion, an ark of the covenant';
sentences.n: Exodus 25:10, 25:40 (make it after the pattern shown on the mountain). ወለሙሴኒ: 'and to Moses also' (-ኒ). ይቤሎ: 3ms of the defective ብህለ, 'he said to him'. ግበር: 2ms imperative. በአምሳሊሃ ለጽዮን 'in her likeness, of Zion': the suffix -ሃ anticipates the owner ለጽዮን. The theology to note: the earthly Ark is a copy of heavenly Zion, which the Ethiopian Zion/Ark idea turns on. ታቦተ ኪዳን 'ark of covenant' is a second, appositive accusative.

sentences.t: ወዳዊትኒ ፡ አመ ፡ ይነሥኣ ፡ እምሀገረ ፡ ሰማርያ ፡ አንበራ ፡ ለታቦተ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሐዲስ ፡ ታቦት ፡ ወተፈሥሐ ፡ በቅድሜሃ ፤
sentences.l: and-David-also when he-takes-her from-city-of Samaria he-set-her to-ark-of law in new ark and-he-rejoiced before-her;
sentences.i: And David also, when he took her from the city of Samaria, set the Ark of the Law in a new ark, and rejoiced before her;
sentences.n: 2 Samuel 6 (and 1 Chronicles 13, 15): David brings the Ark up with rejoicing, on a new cart. Two slips in the source, kept as printed: ሰማርያ 'Samaria' (the Ark came from Kiriath-jearim/Baale-judah, and Samaria did not yet exist), and ሐዲስ ታቦት 'a new ark' where 2 Samuel has a new cart. ይነሥኣ: imperfect 'he takes her' after አመ 'when', here past ('when he took her'). አንበራ ለታቦተ: ለ- marks the object after the suffix -ኣ 'her'. ተፈሥሐ: ተ-stem 'rejoiced'. በቅድሜሃ 'before her' (the Ark is feminine).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ረሰያ ፡ ለታቦት ፡ መድኀኒተ ፡ እምትካት ፡ ወተገብረ ፡ ባቲ ፡ በአርአያ ፡ ወአምሳል ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ ተኣምር ፡ ወመንክር ፨
sentences.l: for he-made-her to-ark saviour from-ትካት(?) and-it-was-done in-her in-form and-likeness many sign and-wonder
sentences.i: for He made the Ark a saviour in turn (?), and through her, in form and likeness, many signs and wonders were done.
sentences.n: እስመ 'for'. ረሰያ ለታቦት መድኀኒተ: 'he made her, the Ark, a saviour': ረሰየ takes two accusatives (object, then predicate መድኀኒተ), and ለታቦት repeats the object after the suffix. እምትካት is an old uncertain item: the house entry has 'from the foundation, from of old (?)', but in this chapter (here and in unit 10) the sense 'in turn, in exchange, in its place' (cf. ተካ 'replace') fits better, so I read it 'in turn (?)', leave ትካት as printed in l, and flag it for the glosser (the entry አምትካት needs broadening). ተገብረ: 3ms passive 'was done'; the subject is the pair ተኣምር ወመንክር, singular nouns after ብዙኅ, so the singular verb is regular. ባቲ 'in/through her'. በአርአያ ወአምሳል 'in appearance and likeness' (አርአያ 'pattern, form'). ተኣምር 'sign, miracle' and መንክር 'wonder'. The ፨ closes the sentence.

sentences.t: ስመዑኒ ፡ ወጥዩቀ ፡ እከሥት ፡ ለክሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ ወሀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ መድኀኒተ ፡ በዕፀ ፡ መስቀሉ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ እምቀዳሚ ፡ እስከ ፡ ደኃሪ ።
sentences.l: hear-then and-exactly I-will-reveal to-you as he-gave God salvation by-wood-of cross-his in-midst-of ark-of law-his from-first until last.
sentences.i: Listen, then, and I will show you exactly how God gave salvation through the wood of His cross, within the Ark of His law, from the first to the last.
sentences.n: A turn from the list to the sermon proper. ስመዑኒ: ስመዑ (as printed; the usual spelling is ስምዑ), 2mp imperative of ሰምዐ 'hear', + -ኒ 'then, now'; no object is expressed. ወጥዩቀ: 'and exactly' (accusative adverb). እከሥት: 1cs subjunctive, 'I will reveal, make plain'. በከመ ወሀበ 'as he gave', 'how he gave'. The central claim: salvation is by wood, the cross, and it was already present in the Ark of the Law, so the Ark is the type and the cross the fulfilment. እምቀዳሚ እስከ ደኃሪ 'from the first until the last' (adjectives used as nouns).

sentences.t: በዕፅ ፡ ኮነ ፡ መድኀኒቱ ፡ ለአዳም ፡ እስመ ፡ በዕፅ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ቀዳሚ ፡ ስሕተቱ ፡ ለአዳም ፡ ወበዕፅ ፡ ረሰየ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ መድኀኒተ ፡ እምትካት ፤
sentences.l: in-wood it-was salvation-his to-Adam for in-wood it-was first error-his to-Adam and-in-wood he-made to-him salvation from-ትካት(?);
sentences.i: Through wood came Adam's salvation, for through wood came Adam's first error, and through wood He made salvation for him in turn (?);
sentences.n: The tree of Genesis 2–3 against the cross (the 'tree' of Deuteronomy 21:23, Galatians 3:13, Acts 5:30). Plain parallelism: በዕፅ ኮነ 'through wood it was' twice, then ረሰየ ሎቱ መድኀኒተ 'he made for him salvation' (ሎቱ 'to him'). መድኀኒቱ ለአዳም 'Adam's salvation' (suffix -ሁ anticipating the owner). ቀዳሚ ስሕተቱ 'his first error' (the primal fall). እምትካት: see unit 8, 'in turn (?)'; 'from of old' is the house entry, uncertain.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ለሊሁ ፡ እግዚእ ፡ ፈጣሪ ፡ ወሃቤ ፡ ሕይወት ፡ ወሞት ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ይትገበር ፡ በቃሉ ፡ ወለኵሉ ፡ ው ፡ እቱ ፡ ፈጠረ ፡ ወያጸድቆ ፡ ለዘ ፡ ይትቀነይ ፡ በንጹሕ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ንጽሕት ፤
sentences.l: for he-himself lord creator giver-of life and-death and-all it-is-done by-word-his and-all he created and-he-justifies-him to-whoever he-serves in-purity in-midst-of ark-of law-his pure;
sentences.i: For He Himself is Lord, Creator, giver of life and of death, and everything is done by His word; and He created all, and He declares righteous whoever serves in purity within the Ark of His law, the pure one;
sentences.n: Printed ወለኵሉ ው ፡ እቱ ፈጠረ with a wordspace splitting ውእቱ: a source slip kept as printed (the glossary has a placeholder እቱ). Read ውእቱ 'he' (emphatic, 'he it is who'): ወለኵሉ ውእቱ ፈጠረ 'and all he created', ለኵሉ marking the object. ወሃቤ: 'giver of' (agent noun of ወሀበ; the first ወ is a root letter). ያጸድቆ: 3ms imperfect of አጽደቀ 'justify, declare righteous' + -ኦ 'him', anticipating ለዘ ይትቀነይ 'the one who serves' (ተቀነየ 'serve, be subject'). ንጽሕት is feminine and agrees with ታቦት 'the pure Ark'. Purity is the theme the next sentences develop.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ተሰምየት ፡ ምሥሃል ፡ ወካዕበ ፡ ተሰምየት ፡ ምምሕፃነ ፡ ተሰምየት ፡ ምሥዋዐ ፡ ወተሰምየት ፡ ምስትስራየ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ተሰምየት ፡ መድኀኒት ፡ ወተሰምየት ፡ አንቀጸ ፡ ሕይወት ፡ ተሰምየት ፡ ምክሐ ፡ ወተሰምየት ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ምስካይ ፡ ተሰምየት ፡ ሐመረ ፡ ወተሰምየት ፡ መርሶ ፡ መድኀኒት ፡ ተሰምየት ፡ ቤተ ፡ ጸሎት ፡ ወተሰምየት ፡ ምስትስራየ ፡ ኀጢአት ፡ ለዘ ፡ ሰአለ ፡ በንጹሕ ፡ በውስቴታ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይስአልዎ ፡ በንጹሕ ፡ ወኢያርኵሱ ፡ ሥጋሆሙ ፤
sentences.l: for she-was-called mercy-seat and-again she-was-called womb(?) she-was-called altar and-she-was-called means-of-forgiveness-of sin she-was-called salvation and-she-was-called gate-of life she-was-called boast and-she-was-called city-of refuge she-was-called ship and-she-was-called harbour-of salvation she-was-called house-of prayer and-she-was-called means-of-forgiveness-of sin to-whoever he-asked in-purity in-her that they-ask-him in-purity and-not-they-defile flesh-their;
sentences.i: For she was called the mercy-seat, and again she was called the womb (?), she was called the altar, and she was called a means of forgiveness of sin, she was called salvation, and she was called the gate of life, she was called a boast, and she was called the city of refuge, she was called a ship, and she was called the harbour of salvation, she was called the house of prayer, and she was called a means of forgiveness of sin, for whoever asks in purity within her, that they may ask Him in purity and not defile their flesh;
sentences.n: A litany of names for the Ark, all with ተሰምየት 'she was named' (3fs perfect of ተሰምየ). Forty-one words and no ፤ to cut at, so one unit. Notes: ምሥሃል 'place of mercy, mercy-seat' (from ሣህል 'mercy', as I remember the root (?); cf. Exodus 25:17–22). ምምሕፃነ I cannot place: it may be a form of ማሕፀን 'womb' (so Mary), or a 'cherishing place' from ሐፀነ 'embrace, nurse' (?). ምስትስራየ ኀጢአት 'a means of forgiveness of sin' appears twice as printed. አንቀጸ ሕይወት 'gate of life' (cf. Psalm 118:19–20, which is 117:19–20 in the Greek numbering the Geʿez Psalter follows). ሀገረ ምስካይ 'city of refuge' (Numbers 35; the glossary's ምስካይ 'refuge (?)'). ሐመር 'ship' and መርሶ 'harbour' (Noah's ark as image). ቤተ ጸሎት 'house of prayer' (Isaiah 56:7). ከመ ይስአልዎ 3mp subjunctive + -ዎ 'him'; ወኢያርኵሱ 'and that they not defile' (አርኰሰ).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ ያፈቅር ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ማኅደር ፡ ለንጹሓን ፡ ለእለ ፡ ይበውኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ማኅደሩ ፡ ወይትአኀዙ ፡ በቅድስት ፡ ታቦት ፡ ወይጼልዩ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ ወይሰምዖሙ ፡ ወያድኅኖሙ ፡ እምዕለተ ፡ ምንዳቤሆሙ ፡ ወይገብር ፡ ፈቃዶሙ ፤
sentences.l: for pure he-loves God for he dwelling to-pure-ones to-those-who they-enter in-dwelling-his and-they-hold-fast to-holy ark and-they-pray to-him with-all heart-their and-he-hears-them and-he-saves-them from-day-of distress-their and-he-does will-their;
sentences.i: For God loves the pure, for He is the dwelling of the pure, of those who enter His dwelling and cling to the holy Ark, and pray to Him with all their heart, and He hears them and saves them from the day of their distress and does their will;
sentences.n: The promise attached to the Ark: God dwells with those who come in purity. ንጹሐ 'the pure' (accusative, object of ያፈቅር). ማኅደር ለንጹሓን 'a dwelling for the pure ones' (cf. Psalm 91:1, which is 90:1 in the Greek numbering). ይበውኡ 3mp imperfect of ቦአ 'enter'. ወይትአኀዙ 'and they take hold of, cling to' (ተአኀዘ, 3mp imperfect). ይጼልዩ 'they pray'. ወይሰምዖሙ ወያድኅኖሙ: 3ms imperfect + -ሙ 'them', 'hears them and saves them'. ምንዳቤ 'distress' (cf. Psalm 50:15, which is 49:15 in the Greek numbering: calling on God in the day of trouble).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ አምሳለ ፡ መንበሩ ፡ አስተማሰላ ፡ ለቅድስት ፡ ታቦት ፡ ወቦእለ ፡ ታበውኡነ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይትሜሰሉ ፡ ኪያነ ፡ ክርስቲያነ ፡ ወኢየኀድጎሙ ፡ ስሕተት ፡ በዘ ፡ አሥረፀ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ አቡሆሙ ፡ ዲያብሎስ ፡ ወይብል ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ርቱዕሰ ፡ ንስግድ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ቀዳሚኒ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ወይእዜኒ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ አምሳሊሃኒ ፡ ወፍሬሃኒ ፡ ወላዲተ ፡ መድኅን ፡ ማርያም ፡ ርቱዕ ፡ ንስግድ ፡ ላቲ ፤
sentences.l: for likeness-of throne-his he-made-likeness-for-her to-holy ark and-there-are-those-who they-bring-in-us(?) while they-resemble us Christians and-not it-leaves-them error(?) in-that he-planted to-them father-their Devil and-he-says thus: 'right-indeed we-bow in-midst-of Zion, ark-of law-his of-God; first-indeed she, and-now-also this, likeness-her-also and-fruit-her-also, bearer-of saviour Mary, right we-bow to-her;
sentences.i: For He made a likeness of His throne for the holy Ark; and there are those who lead us in (?) while they liken themselves to us Christians, and the error does not leave them (?), which their father the Devil planted in them, and he says thus: 'It is right indeed that we bow within Zion, the Ark of the Law of God; she was first, and now this one too, her likeness and her fruit, the bearer of the Saviour, Mary: it is right that we bow to her;
sentences.n: A dense sentence; it sets the objection to be answered. አስተማሰላ: an ast- (causative-reflexive) stem of መሰለ 'be like', 3ms perfect, with the dative suffix -ላ 'for her', which ለቅድስት ታቦት repeats: 'he made a likeness (አምሳለ መንበሩ, accusative) of his throne for the holy Ark'. The other reading, 'he made the holy Ark a likeness of his throne', would take -ላ as 'her'; either way the Ark copies the heavenly throne (cf. Hebrews 8:5). ወቦእለ: 'and there are those who' (ቦ + እለ). ታበውኡነ: printed with the prefix ታ-, which with the plural ending -ኡ is 2mp ('you bring us in'; 3fs would have no -ኡ); a 3mp ያበውኡነ 'who bring us in' is what the grammar wants, and l and i follow that emendation, and the sense ('lead us in', perhaps into their error) is uncertain (?). ይትሜሰሉ ኪያነ ክርስቲያነ 'they resemble us, Christians' (ኪያነ the accusative 'us', ክርስቲያነ in apposition). 'Their father the Devil' echoes John 8:44. አሥረፀ 'caused to sprout, planted' (the causative of ሠረፀ). ወይብል 'and he says' (the objector, or the Devil). ኢየኀድጎሙ ስሕተት: the verb is masculine and ስሕተት feminine, so 'the error does not leave them' is a likely sense, not a certain one (?). ርቱዕሰ ንስግድ በውስተ ጽዮን ታቦተ ሕጉ: ጽዮን and ታቦተ ሕጉ stand in apposition (Zion is the Ark, as in ch. 1), and ሰገደ takes ለ- for the person bowed to, so there is no 'to the Ark' here. The objector's view as I read it: the Zion Ark, Mary (as the Ark's 'likeness and fruit', ወላዲተ መድኅን 'bearer of the Saviour') and the angels deserve worship, but not the arks of the saints; unit 17 onward answers it. ርቱዕሰ with -ሰ 'right indeed'; ቀዳሚኒ with -ኒ 'first indeed'.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ተባረከ ፡ በስመ ፡ ዚአሃ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: for it-was-blessed in-name hers ark-of law-his of-God;
sentences.i: for the Ark of the Law of God was blessed in her name;
sentences.n: The reason given for bowing to Mary: the Ark is blessed by her name. ተባረከ 'was blessed' (passive-reflexive), followed by ታቦተ in the accusative form where a nominative subject would be expected, a small oddity I keep as printed. ዚአሃ 'hers' (ዚአ + -ሃ), Mary's in this reading. The sense, in my reading: the Ark's blessing comes from what it prefigures, Mary.

sentences.t: ወለሚካኤል ፡ ወለገብርኤል ፡ ርቱዕ ፡ ንስግድ ፨
sentences.l: and-to-Michael and-to-Gabriel right we-bow'
sentences.i: and to Michael and to Gabriel it is right that we bow.'
sentences.n: The objector's list ends at ፨ with the archangels. ርቱዕ ንስግድ 'it is right (that) we bow' (ንስግድ, 1cp subjunctive of ሰገደ), with ለ- 'to' marking the person bowed to. In context, 'bow' (ሰገደ) is the verb for reverence given to the Ark, to the saints' arks and to Christ, so the argument turns on to whom reverence is owed.

sentences.t: ወአውሥኦሙ ፡ ሊቀ ፡ ጳጳሳት ፡ ጌርሎስ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ወዘንተ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ ንሕነኒ ፡ ንብሎሙ ፡ ምንተ ፡ ይቤ ፡ እግዚእነ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይሜህሮሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ አምኑ ፡ ቦቱ ፤
sentences.l: and-he-answered-them chief-of bishops Cyril and-he-said-to-them: 'and-this when he-said-to-them, we-also we-say-to-them: what he-said lord-our Jesus Christ while he-teaches-them to-those-who they-believed in-him;
sentences.i: And the chief of the bishops, Cyril, answered them and said to them: 'And when he has said this to them, we for our part say to them: What did our Lord Jesus Christ say while He was teaching those who believed in Him?
sentences.n: The reply begins. ሊቀ ጳጳሳት 'chief of bishops' (construct) is the patriarch; ጌርሎስ is Cyril, I take of Alexandria (?); the spelling is as printed (I would expect ቄርሎስ, so it may be a variant or a slip). His speech opens here and runs to the end of the part (closing quote in unit 32). ሶበ ይቤሎሙ: ሶበ with the perfect, 'when he has said it to them'. ወአውሥኦሙ: 'and he answered them'. ወዘንተ ሶበ ይቤሎሙ: 'and this, when he says to them', the 'he' being the objector; ንሕነኒ 'we also'. ንብሎሙ 'let us say to them / we say to them'. The question is rhetorical and the quotation follows. ለእለ አምኑ ቦቱ 'to those who believed in him' (አምኑ 3mp perfect).

sentences.t: መጽአ ፡ ፩ ፡ እምአፍአ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ነዮሙ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ወእምከ ፡ አፍአ ፡ የኀሡከ ፤
sentences.l: he-came 1 from-outside and-he-said-to-him: "behold-them father-your and-mother-your outside they-seek-you";
sentences.i: One came from outside and said to Him: "See, your father and your mother are outside, seeking you";
sentences.n: Matthew 12:46–50 and Mark 3:31–35 (also Luke 8:19–21): the family waits outside while Jesus teaches. The Gospels say 'mother and brothers'; the source says 'father and mother', kept as printed, and it carries through this passage (unit 19 adds father as well). መጽአ ፩ 'one came' (፩ is the numeral 1, here 'someone'). ነዮሙ: ነዮ 'behold' with a 3mp suffix, used as a plain 'behold, see'. የኀሡከ: 3mp imperfect of ኀሠሠ 'seek' + -ከ 'you'. Note አፍአ 'outside' used twice.

sentences.t: አውሥአ ፡ መፍቀሬ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ክርስቶስ ፡ ወሰፍሐ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እለ ፡ ይሜህሮሙ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ኢይፈልጥ ፡ ወኢይሌሊ ፡ ዕደ ፡ ወአንስተ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ነዮሙ ፡ አቡየ ፡ ወእምየ ፡ ወአኀውየ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘሰምዐ ፡ ቃልየ ፡ ወገብረ ፡ ፈቃደ ፡ አቡየ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አቡየኒ ፡ ወእምየኒ ፡ ወእኅትየኒ ፡ ኦዕዉረ ፡ ልብ ፡ አይሁዳዊ ፡ ትሬኢኑ ፡ ምሕረቶ ፡ ወአፍቅሮቶ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይብል ፡ ከመዝ ፤
sentences.l: he-answered lover-of man Christ and-he-stretched hand-his toward those-who he-teaches-them and-he-said while not he-distinguishes and-not he-separates men and-women and-he-said: "behold-them father-my and-mother-my and-brothers-my; all who-he-heard word-my and-did will-of father-my, he father-my-also and-mother-my-also and-sister-my-also"; O-blind-of heart Jew do-you-see mercy-his and-love-his man when he-says thus;
sentences.i: Christ, the lover of mankind, answered, and stretched out His hand toward those He was teaching, and said, making no distinction or separation between men and women, and He said: "See my father and my mother and my brothers: everyone who has heard my word and done the will of my Father, he is my father, and my mother, and my sister." O Jew, blind of heart, do you see His mercy and His love for man when He speaks thus?
sentences.n: Matthew 12:49–50 / Mark 3:34–35: whoever does the will of the Father is Christ's brother, sister and mother. The source adds 'father' (see unit 18). መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of mankind' (a standard liturgical title: construct of መፍቀሪ + ሰብእ). ሰፍሐ እዴሁ 'spread out his hand' (Matthew 12:49 has him point to the disciples). ኢይፈልጥ ወኢይሌሊ: 'not distinguishing and not separating', male from female; ዕደ ወአንስተ 'men and women'. ዘሰምዐ ... ወገብረ 'who heard ... and did' (ዘ + 3ms perfect). ኦዕዉረ ልብ 'O blind of heart' (vocative, construct). ትሬኢኑ: 2ms imperfect of ርእየ + -ኑ (question). The 'blind Jew' is the book's standing polemical figure, addressed here as an imagined opponent; I translate it as it stands.

sentences.t: ኢፈለጠ ፡ ወኢሌለየ ፡ አላ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ አኀውየ ፡ እስመ ፡ ያፈቅሮሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ያፈቅርዎ ፡ ወየዐቅቡ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ወዓዲ ፡ በእንቲአሁ ፡ መጠዉ ፡ ነፍሶሙ ፡ ለሞት ፡ እንዘ ፡ ያአምሩ ፡ ምረራ ፡ ለሞት ፡ ሰማዕት ፤
sentences.l: not he-distinguished and-not he-separated but he-said-to-them: "brothers-my", for he-loves-them to-those-who they-love-him and-they-keep command-his and-moreover for-sake-his they-gave souls-their to-death while they-know bitterness-of death martyrs;
sentences.i: He made no distinction and no separation, but He said to them, "My brothers," because He loves those who love Him and keep His commandment, and moreover, for His sake they gave their lives to death, knowing the bitterness of death: the martyrs;
sentences.n: The conclusion drawn from the family saying: those who do God's will, above all the martyrs, are Christ's brothers. ኢፈለጠ ወኢሌለየ: 'he did not distinguish, did not separate' (3ms perfects, picking up the imperfects እንዘ ኢይፈልጥ ወኢይሌሊ of unit 19). ለእለ ያፈቅርዎ ... ወየዐቅቡ 'those who love him ... and keep'. ትእዛዞ 'his commandment' (noun + -ሁ). መጠዉ ነፍሶሙ ለሞት 'they handed over their souls to death' (መጠወ). ምረራ ለሞት 'the bitterness of death' (ምረራ looks like a construct and ለሞት adds ለ- naming the possessor; the form is uncertain (?)). ሰማዕት 'witnesses, martyrs', in apposition.

sentences.t: ወፈላሲ ፡ ያን ፡ እለ ፡ የዐቅቡ ፡ ትእዛዞ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአፍቀርዎ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ልቦሙ ፡ ወውእቱኒ ፡ ያፈቅሮሙ ፡ ወዘተሐንጸ ፡ መቃብሪሆሙ ፡ ዘውእቱ ፡ መርጡል ፡ ወዘተሐንጸ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ክርስቲያን ፡ በስሞሙ ፡ ወዘቀደሱ ፡ ጳጳሳት ፡ ታቦታተ ፡ በስሞሙ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ መቅደሱ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: and-pilgrims(?) [printed ፈላሲ ያን; sic] who they-keep command-his of-God and-they-loved-him with-all heart-their and-he-also he-loves-them and-what-was-built tombs-their which martyrium(?) and-what-was-built house-of Christian in-names-their and-what they-consecrated bishops arks in-names-their all holy in-midst-of house-of sanctuary-his of-God;
sentences.i: and the pilgrims (?) who keep the commandment of God and have loved Him with all their heart, and He also loves them; and what was built, their tombs, that is the martyrium (?), and what was built, the church in their names, and what the bishops consecrated, arks in their names: all is holy within the sanctuary of God;
sentences.n: Source slips kept as printed: ወፈላሲ ፡ ያን, where ፈላሲ is singular 'stranger, pilgrim' and ያን is a stray ending; I read it as the plural ፈላስያን 'pilgrims, strangers' (Hebrews 11:13, the exiles of faith), and mark it (?). Because the text is cut by script from the source, I did not mend it. ወውእቱኒ ያፈቅሮሙ 'and he also loves them'. ዘተሐንጸ: ዘ + 3ms perfect passive of ሐነጸ, 'what was built'. መርጡል: the glossary has it uncertain; here 'tombs, that is ...' suggests Greek martyrion 'martyr's shrine, memorial' (?), a guess I hedge (the house entry says 'unidentified', so the gloss entry needs broadening). ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'church'. ዘቀደሱ ጳጳሳት ታቦታተ 'what bishops consecrated: arks', presumably the consecrated tablets of Ethiopian churches (?), as in ch. 103. ኵሉ ቅዱስ 'all (is) holy'. The sentence runs long with no ፤ to cut at.

sentences.t: ወዘሰአለ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ በስሞሙ ፡ ይሰምዖ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: and-whoever he-asked man in-names-their he-hears-him God;
sentences.i: and any man who asks in their names, God hears him;
sentences.n: ዘሰአለ ሰብእ 'any man who asks' (ዘ + 3ms perfect of ሰአለ, ሰብእ in apposition). ይሰምዖ resumes it: 'God hears him'. The practical result of the argument: prayer in the name of the saints is heard.

sentences.t: በንጹሕ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ርስሐት ፡ ወጥልቀት ፡ በትሕትና ፡ ወየውሃት ፡ እለ ፡ ይጼልዩ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ዘተቀደሰ ፡ ታቦት ፡ እመሂ ፡ በስመ ፡ ሰማዕት ፡ ወእመሂ ፡ በስመ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ወእመሂ ፡ በስመ ፡ ጻድቃን ፡ ወእመሂ ፡ በስመ ፡ ደናግል ፡ ወእመሂ ፡ በስመ ፡ ቅዱሳት ፡ አንስት ፡ ሶበ ፡ ተቀደሰ ፡ ይወርድ ፡ መንፈስ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ ወይመይጦ ፡ ለዕፅ ፡ ይኩን ፡ መንፈሳዌ ፤
sentences.l: in-purity without defilement and-stain(?) in-humility and-meekness those-who they-pray toward which-was-consecrated ark whether in-name martyrs and-whether in-name angels and-whether in-name righteous and-whether in-name virgins and-whether in-name holy women when it-was-consecrated it-descends spirit holy upon-them and-he-turns-it to-wood he-be spiritual;
sentences.i: in purity, without defilement or stain (?), in humility and meekness, those who pray toward a consecrated ark, whether in the name of martyrs, or in the name of angels, or in the name of the righteous, or in the name of virgins, or in the name of holy women: when it has been consecrated, the Holy Spirit descends upon them and changes the wood so that it becomes spiritual;
sentences.n: Continues unit 22: how one prays. ዘእንበለ ርስሐት ወጥልቀት 'without impurity and ... ': ጥልቀት I take as 'stain, uncleanness' (?); the word is not secure. ይጼልዩ ኀበ 'they pray toward'. እመሂ ... ወእመሂ: 'whether ... or whether', repeated through five categories of the holy (martyrs, angels, the righteous, virgins, holy women; ቅዱሳት አንስት is the feminine plural with the broken plural አንስት). ተቀደሰ 'was consecrated' (passive of ቀደሰ). ይወርድ 'he/it descends' (3ms imperfect), 'upon them' (ላዕሌሆሙ, the plural arks or the worshippers). ይመይጦ ለዕፅ 'and he turns it, the wood' (ለ- marking the object), then ይኩን jussive 'that it be'. The consecration makes the wood 'spiritual' (መንፈሳዌ), which the two scriptural examples (units 24, 25) are brought to prove.

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ሜጣ ፡ ለበትረ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ በቃሉ ፡ ወኮነት ፡ ዘነፍስ ፡ ወአፍርሀቶ ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ እግዚኦ ፤
sentences.l: as he-turned-her to-rod-of Moses by-word-his and-she-became of-soul(?) and-she-frightened-him to-Moses O-Lord;
sentences.i: as He turned the rod of Moses by His word, and it became living (?), and it frightened Moses: O Lord!
sentences.n: Exodus 4:2–4 (and 7:15), Moses' rod becomes a serpent and he flees. በከመ ሜጣ: 'as he turned her': 3ms perfect of መየጠ 'turn, change' with the 3fs suffix -ኣ (the contraction seen in ረሰያ), so ለበትረ ሙሴ repeats the object; the rod is feminine, as ወኮነት confirms. ወኮነት ዘነፍስ: literally 'and she became of soul', the glossary's 'living (?)': a rod gaining life; the phrase is an odd one and I hedge it. ወአፍርሀቶ: 3fs perfect of አፍርሀ 'frighten' + -ኦ 'him', the rod being the subject. ለሙሴ resumes the suffix. እግዚኦ is the vocative 'O Lord', either Moses' cry or the preacher's.

sentences.t: ወበከመ ፡ ሰገደ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከተማ ፡ በትሩ ፡ ለያዕቆብ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ሀሎ ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ ኢያጻምዎ ፡ አላ ፡ በተአምኖ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ሰገደ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከተማ ፡ በትሩ ፡ ወዝኒ ፡ ዘጸሐፈ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ትንቢት ፡ ለደኃሪ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ከመ ፡ ናእምር ፡ ከመ ፡ ይትቄደሱ ፡ ታቦታት ፡ በስመ ፡ ሰማዕት ፡ ወጻድቃን ፡ እስመ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይሬእዮ ፡ ሰገደ ፡ ለከተማ ፡ በትሩ ፡ ወካዕበ ፡ እነግረከ ፡ ዘተጽሕፈ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ትዕቢቱ ፡ ለፈርዖን ፤
sentences.l: and-as he-bowed Joseph in-midst-of top(?) staff-his of-Jacob while he-was before-him(?) not-it-wearies-him(?) but in-faith father-his he-bowed in-midst-of top(?) staff-his and-this-also what he-wrote Moses prophecy for-last days that we-know that they-are-consecrated arks in-name martyr and-righteous for while he-sees-it he-bowed to-top(?) staff-his and-again I-tell-you what was-written concerning pride-his of-Pharaoh;
sentences.i: And as Joseph bowed to the tip (?) of Jacob's staff, while he (Jacob?) was before him, it did not tire him (?), but in his father's faith he bowed to the tip of his staff; and this too is what Moses wrote, a prophecy for the last days, so that we may know that arks are to be consecrated in the name of martyrs and righteous: for, while he saw it, he bowed to the tip of his staff. And again I tell you what is written concerning the pride of Pharaoh;
sentences.n: Genesis 47:31 as the Greek Old Testament has it and Hebrews 11:21 ('by faith Jacob ... worshipped, leaning on the top of his staff'). Here the one who bows is Joseph, and the staff is Jacob's; I keep that as printed. The argument: the staff is not God, yet reverence to it was no sin, so reverence to a hallowed object in a saint's name is not either. ከተማ 'tip, top' (?) as in unit 5. ኢያጻምዎ: negative 3ms imperfect of አጻመወ + -ዎ 'him', 'weary, trouble': 'it did not tire (or trouble) him' (?). Its subject is unexpressed (perhaps the bowing); ሀሎ 'was' is masculine, so I do not make the feminine staff its subject. ሰገደ ውስተ ከተማ: ሰገደ takes ለ- (as in the last clause); ውስተ is 'to, upon' here. በተአምኖ አቡሁ 'in the faith of his father' (ተአምኖ 'faith'). ዘጸሐፈ ሙሴ 'what Moses wrote' (Moses is taken as the author of Genesis). ከመ ናእምር 'so that we know'; ከመ ይትቄደሱ 'that they are consecrated' (3mp imperfect, passive). ይሬእዮ 'he sees it' (ርእየ, with -ኦ). The unit is about 45 words with no ፤ to cut at.

sentences.t: ሙሴ ፡ ገብረ ፡ በትሮ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ረሰየ ፡ አርዌ ፡ ምድር ፡ ወአዘዞሙ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ለመሠርያን ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግበሩ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ አብትሪሆሙ ፡ ለሰብአ ፡ ሐራስ ፡ ወገብሩ ፡ አብትሪሆሙ ፡ ፫ ፡ አክይስተ ፡ እለ ፡ ይትሐወሳ ፡ በሥራይ ፡ በቅድመ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ወአሮን ፡ ወበቅድመ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ወዐበይተ ፡ ግብጽ ፤
sentences.l: Moses he-made rod-his as he-commanded-him God he-made beast-of earth and-he-commanded-them Pharaoh to-sorcerers that they-make likewise rods-their to-men-of ḥäras(?) and-they-made rods-their 3 serpents which they-moved by-sorcery before Moses and-Aaron and-before Pharaoh and-great-men-of Egypt;
sentences.i: Moses made his rod, as God commanded him, a beast (serpent?) of the earth; and Pharaoh commanded the sorcerers to make likewise their rods, those of the men of Ḥäras (?); and they made their rods into three serpents, which moved by sorcery before Moses and Aaron and before Pharaoh and the great men of Egypt;
sentences.n: Exodus 7:8–12: the rod becomes a serpent and Pharaoh's magicians do the same. In Exodus it is Aaron who casts down the rod; the source puts it in Moses' hand (cf. Exodus 4:3). ገብረ በትሮ ረሰየ አርዌ ምድር: 'he made his rod, he set it, a beast of the earth': the second verb takes the predicate (see the glossary: አርዌ may be 'serpent'). መሠርያን 'sorcerers' (from ሥራይ 'sorcery'). ለሰብአ ሐራስ gives the owners of the rods after the suffix in አብትሪሆሙ: 'their rods, those of the men of ḥäras'. ሰብአ ሐራስ: I do not know ሐራስ; by context 'sorcerers, enchanters' (?) and I translate 'men of Ḥäras' to keep the lack of certainty. ፫ አክይስተ: 'three serpents', the number being the author's, not Exodus's. ይትሐወሳ: 3fp imperfect 'they moved, stirred' (agreeing with አክይስት, feminine plural). ዐበይተ ግብጽ 'great ones of Egypt'.

sentences.t: ወበልዐቶሙ ፡ በትረ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለአብትረ ፡ መሠርያን ፡ እስመ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ሕስዋነ ፡ ስም ፡ ለአርአያ ፡ ዐይነ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ በሥራይ ፡ ገብሩ ፤
sentences.l: and-she-swallowed-them rod-of Moses to-rods-of sorcerers for they falsehoods(?) name for-appearance eye-of man by-sorcery they-made;
sentences.i: and the rod of Moses swallowed the rods of the sorcerers, for they were falsehoods in name only (?), made by sorcery as an appearance for the eyes of men;
sentences.n: Exodus 7:12, Aaron's rod swallows the others. ወበልዐቶሙ (ለአብትረ መሠርያን repeats the object with ለ-): 3fs perfect of በልዐ 'swallow, eat' + -ሙ 'them', with the subject following (በትረ ሙሴ). ሕስዋነ ስም: 'falsehoods of name' or 'mere falsehoods', 'empty in name only' (?); I read ስም 'name' as 'only in name' and ሕስዋን as 'falsehoods, illusions' (?). ለአርአያ ዐይነ ሰብእ 'for the appearance (to) the eye of man' (አርአያ 'appearance'). The sorcerers' serpents are illusions made 'by sorcery' (በሥራይ), against the real change by the word of God.

sentences.t: ወዘሰ ፡ ኮነ ፡ በቃለ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ይመውእ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ሥራየ ፡ ዘተገብረ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይረክቦ ፡ እኩይ ፤
sentences.l: and-what-indeed it-was by-word-of God it-overcomes all sorcery which-was-done and-there-is-not what finds-it evil;
sentences.i: But what comes about by the word of God overcomes all the sorcery that was done, and no evil befalls it;
sentences.n: The rule drawn from Exodus 7: God's word beats magic. ወዘሰ: ወ + ዘ + -ሰ, 'but whatever (indeed)'. ይመውእ 3ms imperfect of መውአ 'overcome, conquer'. ኵሎ ሥራየ 'all sorcery' (accusative). ዘተገብረ 'that was done' (passive relative). ወአልቦ ዘይረክቦ እኩይ: 'and there is nothing evil that finds it' (ዘ + 3ms imperfect + -ኦ 'it'; እኩይ in apposition to ዘ): no evil reaches it.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ መንፈስ ፡ ቅዱስ ፡ ዘይሜግቦ ፡ ወያሰፍኖ ፡ ለዘ ፡ ይትአመን ፡ በርቱዕ ፡ ልብ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ አስትቶ ፤
sentences.l: for he spirit holy who-he-feeds-him(?) and-he-provides-for-him(?) to-whoever he-believes in-upright heart without wavering(?);
sentences.i: for it is the Holy Spirit who feeds him (?) and provides for him (?), whoever believes with an upright heart, without wavering (?);
sentences.n: ውእቱ መንፈስ ቅዱስ 'it is the Holy Spirit' (the cause of the power in unit 28). ዘይሜግቦ: relative + 3ms imperfect of መገበ 'feed, nourish' + -ኦ 'him' (?). ወያሰፍኖ: causative of ሰፈነ, 'makes him abound, provides for him' (?). Both verbs I give as best guesses without Dillmann. ለዘ ይትአመን 'to whoever believes' (ተአመነ, 'trust, have faith'). በርቱዕ ልብ 'with an upright heart'. ዘእንበለ አስትቶ: I cannot parse አስትቶ with confidence; 'without wavering, doubt' fits (cf. James 1:6) but the word is a guess from context (?).

sentences.t: በከመ ፡ ይቤ ፡ ጳውሎስ ፡ በተአምኖ ፡ ድኅኑ ፡ አበው ፡ ቀደምት ፡ ፈቀደ ፡ ወአጠየቀ ፡ በበ ፡ ስሞሙ ፡ እምአዳም ፡ ወኖኅ ፡ ወአብርሃም ፡ ወእስከ ፡ ራአብ ፡ ዘማ ፡ እንተ ፡ ተወክፈቶሙ ፡ ለሰብአ ፡ ዐይን ፡ ወአንተኒ ፡ ኦዕዉር ፡ አይሁዳዊ ፡ ኢትሌቡኑ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ሕግ ፡ ዘታነብብ ፡ ዘውእቱ ፡ ዘትትአመን ፡ ኦሪትከ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ኢትክል ፡ አስልጦ ፡ ትእዛዛቲሃ ፡ ወርጉም ፡ አንተ ፡ ባቲ ፤
sentences.l: as he-said Paul: "by-faith they-were-saved fathers ancient"; he-wished and-he-set-out-exactly by-by names-their from-Adam and-Noah and-Abraham and-until Rahab harlot who she-received-them to-men-of eye(?) and-you-also O-blind Jew not-you-understand in-midst-of law which-you-read which he which-you-believe Orit-your while not you-can to-carry-out(?) commands-hers and-cursed you in-her;
sentences.i: As Paul said, "By faith the ancient fathers were saved"; he wished and set out exactly, name by name, from Adam and Noah and Abraham, and as far as Rahab the harlot, who received the spies (?). And you also, blind Jew: do you not understand in the law which you read, that is, which you trust, your Orit, while you cannot carry out (?) its commandments, and you are cursed by it?
sentences.n: Hebrews 11, the chapter on faith, which in the source runs through the fathers by name; Rahab the harlot received the men sent to look over Jericho (Hebrews 11:31; Joshua 2), so ሰብአ ዐይን would be 'spies' (?). Note that Hebrews 11 itself begins with Abel and Enoch; 'from Adam' is the author's summary. ድኅኑ: 3mp perfect 'were saved'. ፈቀደ ወአጠየቀ: 'he wished and set out exactly'. በበ ስሞሙ 'by their names' (distributive). ሰብአ ዐይን 'men of the eye' = spies (?). ኦሪት is the Orit, the Law/Torah, a word to learn. ኢትሌቡኑ: 'do you not understand?' (negative + -ኑ question), the verb taking a plural-looking shape; I keep it as printed. አስልጦ 'to carry out, to master' (a causative infinitive, perhaps of ሰልጠ 'have power'; 'carry out, fulfil' is a guess from the context (?)). ርጉም አንተ ባቲ 'accursed are you in it', a first echo of the curse of unit 31.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ይብል ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ የሐውሩ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ለእመ ፡ ኢዐቀቡ ፡ ዘጽሑፍ ፡ ውስቴታ ፡ ርጉመ ፡ ለይኩን ፡ ይብለከ ፤
sentences.l: for it-says all to-those-who they-walk in-her: "if not they-kept what-is-written in-her, cursed let-him-be", it-says-to-you;
sentences.i: For it says of all who walk in it: "If they do not keep what is written in it, let him be accursed," it says to you;
sentences.n: Galatians 3:10 quoting Deuteronomy 27:26: the curse on whoever does not keep all that is written in the Law. The number shifts (plural ኢዐቀቡ, singular ለይኩን) as printed. The point of the argument: under the Law as the Jew reads it, no one can escape the curse, which only faith (Mark 16:16 below) answers. ይብል 'it says'. ኵሎሙ ለእለ የሐውሩ ባቲ 'all of those who walk in it' (3mp imperfect of ሖረ). ለእመ 'if'. ዘጽሑፍ 'what is written' (passive participle). ርጉመ ለይኩን: accusative predicate 'cursed' + jussive ለይኩን 'let him be'. ይብለከ: 3ms 'says to you'.

sentences.t: ወለነሰ ፡ ለእለ ፡ አመነ ፡ በክርስቶስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ኀረየነ ፡ ጸጋ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ ዘአምነ ፡ ወተጠምቀ ፡ ይድኀን ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: and-as-for-us to-those-who he-believed in-Christ son-of God he-chose-us grace-of God while he-says: "whoever-he-believed and-he-was-baptized he-will-be-saved"'
sentences.i: But as for us, who have believed in Christ, the Son of God, the grace of God has chosen us, saying: "Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved."'
sentences.n: Mark 16:16 (belief and baptism bring salvation). The answer to the curse of units 30–31. ወለነሰ: 'and as for us' (ወ + ለ + -ነ + -ሰ). ለእለ አመነ: relative plural with a singular verb አመነ, a small mismatch noted in the glossary. ኀረየነ: 3ms perfect 'chose us'. ጸጋ እግዚኣብሔር 'grace of God' (construct), the subject. ዘአምነ ወተጠምቀ ይድኀን: 'whoever believed and was baptized, he will be saved' (ተጠምቀ, passive 'was baptized'). The six ፨ at the end close the part as printed, and Cyril's speech, begun in unit 17, ends here.
